text:
sam: Quick question before I book  I'm heading to Tokyo for a week. Can I use my personal card and claim meals as per-diem? Also any rules about booking hotels outside the portal?

nora_people_ops: Yes you can use a personal card if corporate card isn't available, but prefer Travel Portal bookings for negotiated rates and insurance. For meals: you can choose per-diem or actual receipts, not both. For Japan we use the country per-diem table: JPY equivalent of $110/day USD.

ben: What's the approval flow for business class on a long overnight flight? Mine is ~11 hours.

nora_people_ops: Economy is default. For single-leg flights >8 hours you can request premium economy/business but you need manager + People Ops pre-approval. Add the approval note in the booking or attach the email to your expense report. If approved after booking, reimbursements may be reviewed more carefully.

sam: Lost receipt scenario  I lost a taxi receipt on arrival.

nora_people_ops: Submit the Lost Receipt Affidavit in Expensify and attach a card statement line showing the charge plus a manager attestation. For amounts under $20 we may accept a card statement + short note without affidavit.

taylor_manager: I can pre-approve Sam for premium economy if People Ops signs off. Please add reason (health/recovery or meeting prep) to the request.

ben: Foreign currency conversion  should I attach the merchant receipt in JPY or a converted USD copy?

nora_people_ops: Attach the original merchant receipt in local currency. Expensify will capture the local amount and convert using the report date rate. Finance reconciles reimbursements in USD. If you need reimbursement in local currency for an extended stay, contact payroll/finance.

sam: Hotel holds  the incidental hold was huge. Will Redwood cover that?

nora_people_ops: Pre-authorizations are not reimbursed; they drop off with the issuer. If the hotel posts an actual incidental charge, submit the folio. If possible, use corporate card for incidentals to avoid personal holds.

expensebot: Expensify: report "TPE - Tokyo trip - Sam" created by sam  status: needs manager approval.

sam: Thanks all  I'll book via portal where possible and upload everything to Expensify within 14 days.

taylor_manager: Approved pending receipts and People Ops signoff on premium economy if you go that route.
